summary: Frontend-only test of the static Jekyll site IEEE CYB Conf 2027 (/app/cybconf). A crawler checked 13 pages: every page returned 200, no internal assets or links were broken (CSS background images included), and every nav anchor ID (#theme-topics, #regular-topics, #important-dates, #paper-types, #tpc, #tourism, #cuisine, #food-gallery) exists. Playwright on desktop (1920): the home hero, theme, dates, key dates card (Jan 15 / Mar 1 / Mar 31 / Mar 31 2027), Topics, Scientific Program, Discover Calabria, Organizing Committee (placeholder avatars render), Calabria conferences archive, venue and sponsors all render. All 39 home images load. All 5 dropdowns open with the expected items. No JS page errors. Mobile (390): the toggler opens the collapse, the Attending dropdown expands, the Registration link navigates, and there is no horizontal overflow on 7 pages. Fixed one bug: the 'Motion & Control' topic card had no icon.

ui_bugs.component: Home Topics Covered - Motion & Control card
ui_bugs.issue: Icon did not render. bi-person-walking does not exist in Bootstrap Icons 1.10.5, the version loaded in _layouts/default.html. FIXED by switching to bi-arrows-move.

issues: Copyright reads '© 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cybernetics 2027' (site.time year). This may look inconsistent; consider hardcoding it or dropping the year.
custom-index.css .contact-hero uses /assets/images/Digital_Twin_Calgary.jpg, which looks like a leftover from a previous conference. Consider a Calabria/UNICAL image.
Justified paragraph text leaves large word gaps at 390px. Consider text-align:left on mobile (inherited from the original site).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Jekyll site served on port 3000. Run python /app/tests/crawl_check.py to check status, assets, links and leftover SWC text. The site has no data-testids; use text/CSS selectors (.navbar-toggler, nav .dropdown-toggle, a.dropdown-item).
